item.goety_aether.sentry_focus.info: Summons loyal Sentry Servants for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.battle_sentry_focus.in: Summons loyal Battle Sentry Servants for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.tracking_golem_focus.i: Summons loyal Tracking Golems for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.sentry_golem_focus.inf: Summons loyal Sentry Golems for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.eotsservant_spawn_egg: Eye of the Storm Servant Spawn Egg
item.goety_aether.pickaxe_attack_focus.i: Grants the caster Pickaxe Strike, allowing melee or ranged attacks against Sliders without a pickaxe.
item.goety_aether.zephyr_focus.info: Summons loyal Zephyr Servants for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.baby_zephyr_focus.info: Summons loyal Baby Zephyr Servants for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.sky_hunter_focus.info: Summons a loyal Sky Wolf Servant for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.cockatrice_focus.info: Summons a loyal Cockatrice Servant for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.poison_dart_rain_focus: Rains poison darts down upon the target area.
lore.item.goety_aether.poison_dart_rain_: The anchor plant toxins can be used as a powerful weapon. With just a brief ritual, you can turn them into a focus unit that launches deadly poison darts at your target when casting.
item.goety_aether.valkyrie_focus.info: Summons a loyal Valkyrie Servant for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.solar_focus.info: Summons a loyal Fire Minion Servant for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
item.goety_aether.tempest_focus.info: Summons a loyal Tempest Servant for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
Shoots a Thunder Crystal at the targeted creature. Requires a living target in the crosshair.
item.goety_aether.cloud_breath_focus.inf: Shoots a torrent of clouds in front of them, harming non-allied targets and leaving a damaging cloud behind.
item.goety_aether.cloud_falling_focus.in: Drops clouds from above to strike enemies.
info.goety_aether.divine_crown: Divine and Wind servants persist forever.
info.goety_aether.divine_crown_cast: Halves casting time for all spells.
info.goety_aether.divine_robe: Damage taken from undead is reduced by 20%.
info.goety_aether.divine_robe_flight: Grants slow falling while airborne, negating fall damage.
attribute.name.goety.divine_potency.desc: Increases the power of Goety Divine spells.
lore.item.goety_aether.arkenzus_codex: The Codex of Arkenzus isn't something every life form can easily understand. But if you force those dead one to grasp this power, you'll end up creating a twisted and profane reborn servant.
lore.item.goety_aether.swollen_sun: Swollen Sun is the burning divine power of the origin of flames. By using it, followers of the Sun will obey you and become your servants who manipulate fire.
item.goety_aether.superstorm_focus.info: Summons a loyal Eye of the Storm for the caster. Cast crouching will teleport the servants to the caster's location.
lore.block.goety_aether.plushie: According to unverifiable historical records, this was once the portrait of the first Unknown to study forbidden magic in Aether. It is said that their shattered dark soul still lingers in voodoo dolls to this day.
resourcePack.goety_aether.einheri_valkyr: Replaces the Zombie Valkyrie Queen with the Einheri Valkyrie Queen skin.
item.goety_aether.c_moon_focus.info: Gathers the power of the new moon at the gazed position, constantly pulling nearby creatures.
item.goety_aether.repel_focus.info: Gathers the power of formation-breaking at the gazed position, constantly pushing nearby creatures away.
item.goety_aether.levitation_focus.info: Makes the target float. Sneak to cast on yourself.
item.goety_aether.divine_favor_focus.inf: Leaves a golden circle that continuously heals nearby allies.
lore.item.goety_aether.ice_crystal_focus: When Thilus embedded the Ice Titan Ring into the body of the Sun Spirit, His flame power was suppressed by ice. With the help of a ritual, you can use this focus to call on the power of Icey Titan Ring and shoot an Icey Ball at your target!
lore.item.goety_aether.fire_crystal_focu: Flame Power is the primal force of the Sun Spirit. As the energy of the ritual spreads, you can use this focus to call upon the Sun Spirit's original power and launch a rolling Firo Ball at your target!
lore.item.goety_aether.pickaxe_attack_fo: This focus has unusual powers. With a simple ritual, it can let you bypass the solid rock shell of the Slider and resonate with its core directly. It's said that some valkyries use this power when servicing sentries.
lore.item.goety_aether.thunder_crystal_f: Usually, the elemental energy mastered by a high-level valkyrie gets infused into those angelic bricks, attaching a spell to them, which can turn them into a focus cluster. Using it for casting allows you to launch thundro balls at your target!
lore.item.goety_aether.valkyrie_focus: Such hostile spells have long been banned in Aether. Focus units completed in this way forcibly strip the Valkyrie's will and turn her into a servant of darkness for the caster to use.
lore.item.goety_aether.solar_focus: the Sun Spirit followers seek power from the outside. As long as you possess the power of the Flame Essence, they'll willingly offer their power to you and become servants controlled by you. The thing is, so far, no one has dared to do this in Aether.
lore.item.goety_aether.cockatrice_focus: Mutations and stubborn illnesses can't be stopped even in Aether,. Focus units that use pure darkness as ritual material can turn creatures from overworld into blighted monsters and let the caster control them.
lore.item.goety_aether.sentry_focus: The magic related to sentry technology has long been lost, but there are still some forbidden casters who try to use it. Even so, these focus clusters can only form the most basic shape of sentries.
lore.item.goety_aether.zephyr_focus: Nothing is better suited for dark rituals than pure elements. Trying to mix Aether elements with Overworld focus can create the most perfect servant creatures. Usually, the purest elemental beings are the easiest to enslave.
lore.item.goety_aether.levitation_focus: A ring-shaped focus unit made of gravitite. It seems to continuously emit a gravitational field. By using it to cast, you can float yourself or make your target gravitless!
lore.item.goety_aether.aether_access_rin: Using a Pickaxe Attack Focus, you can craft a Ring of Access through a ritual. It allows the wearer to be recognized by the will of Aether Spirit, and any tool brought up into the sky will no longer be restricted!
lore.item.goety_aether.unbounded_water_b: A bucket that uses a special sink to hold water, it seems like it never runs out.
lore.item.goety_aether.divine_favor_focu: This focus unit has the powerful healing ability of the ambrosium. It balances out the huge backlash of ambrosium energy, allowing you to use it to safely heal yourself without being harmed by ambrosium radiation.
lore.item.goety_aether.divine_staff: Research on the lost Aether Magic was banned long ago, but there are still daring spellcasters who try to tap into these unstable power, using their homemade staff to tune and control it.
lore.item.goety_aether.divine_crown: Divine Crown is part of the Divine Robe; it makes the outfit more complete and lets your servants  persist forever.
lore.item.goety_aether.divine_robe: Divine Robe is part of the Divine Robe set. It makes the outfit more complete and halves your divine spell soul consumption.
